data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that embeds Google Blockly for visual programming.
data.what_it_does: It provides a Blockly editor inside a Flutter app, exposing methods to inject, update, and retrieve code in multiple languages. The editor runs in a WebView on mobile and a native iframe on web.
use_when: You need a drag‑and‑drop coding interface for users
You want to support multiple target languages (Dart, JS, Python, etc.)
You target Android, iOS, web, and macOS with a single code base
avoid_when: You require native performance or low memory footprint
You need a fully custom block set that cannot be loaded via XML
You are building a lightweight app that cannot afford a WebView
strengths: Rich API for injecting, updating, and retrieving code
Supports many languages out of the box
weaknesses: Depends on WebView which adds overhead
Limited customization of the Blockly UI beyond XML
Requires platform‑specific setup for web and mobile
data.setup_notes: Add webview_flutter to pubspec, configure AndroidManifest and iOS Info.plist for WebView, import flutter_blockly and instantiate BlocklyEditorWidget.
